title: The Influence of Fortified Pomegranate Juice (Punica Granatum) on Seasonal Influenza and Swine Flu Patients
brief_summary: It has been shown in laboratory studies that pomegranate juice contains anti-viral action against influenza. The researchers wish to investigate the effect of pomegranate juice on patients suffering from influenza A (seasonal or swine flu).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals confirmed and suffering from Influenza A

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals suffering from influenza included in the high risk group
